title: United sack Carrick after one win in ten and turn to Pochettino
summary: Manchester United sacked head coach Michael Carrick after one win in ten Premier League matches left the club in the relegation zone, and are finalising a deal to appoint Mauricio Pochettino. The club said it reached the conclusion that a change was necessary. Pochettino, currently in charge of the United States, is expected to take training on 18 or 19 November and to face Liverpool away on 22 November.
